   539	  function supportReasonCodesInPack(): string[] {
   540	    const codes = new Set<string>();
   541	    const walk = (node: unknown): void => {
   542	      if (Array.isArray(node)) return node.forEach(walk);
   543	      if (node === null || typeof node !== "object") return;
   544	      const record = node as Record<string, unknown>;
   545	      const effect = record.effect as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   546	      if (
   547	        effect &&
   548	        effect.type === "SUPPORT" &&
   549	        typeof effect.reason_code === "string"
   550	      ) {
   551	        codes.add(effect.reason_code);
   552	      }
   553	      Object.values(record).forEach(walk);
   554	    };
   555	    productionPackFiles().forEach((file) => {
   556	      walk(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf-8")));
   557	    });
   558	    return [...codes].sort();
   559	  }

  1082	describe("review reasons cover every code the current pack can emit", () => {
  1083	  const HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
  1084	  const PACKS_DIR = path.resolve(
  1085	    HERE,
  1086	    "../../../../../../..",

  1090	  /**
  1091	   * Unlike SUPPORT reason codes (grown purely additively, seq-1 through
  1092	   * seq-8, `supportReasonCodesInPack` above safely globs every file), the
  1093	   * HUMAN_REVIEW taxonomy was CONSOLIDATED at seq-6: rulepack-prod-001/002/
  1094	   * 004/005 carried 51-53 granular review codes that were renamed/merged
  1095	   * down to a stable 14 in seq-6/7/8 (verified identical across those
  1096	   * three). Globbing every pack file for review codes would resurrect that
  1097	   * dead pre-seq-6 taxonomy as a permanent "known gap" that can never
  1098	   * actually fire again — so this reads only the pack with the HIGHEST
  1099	   * `sequence` field on disk (the one closest to going live, same
  1100	   * "not-yet-activated" blind-spot concern `supportReasonCodesInPack`
  1101	   * documents, without the false positives a full-file glob would add).
  1102	   */
  1103	  function latestProductionPackFile(): string {
  1104	    const files = fs
  1105	      .readdirSync(PACKS_DIR)
  1106	      .filter((name) => /^rulepack-prod-\d+\.source\.json$/.test(name));
  1107	    if (files.length === 0) {
  1108	      throw new Error(`no production packs found under ${PACKS_DIR}`);
  1109	    }
  1110	    let best: { file: string; sequence: number } | null = null;
  1111	    for (const name of files) {
  1112	      const full = path.join(PACKS_DIR, name);
  1113	      const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(full, "utf-8")) as {
  1114	        sequence?: unknown;
  1115	      };
  1116	      // A pack without a numeric `sequence` cannot be compared — skip it
  1117	      // rather than let it silently win via a sentinel default (a pack
  1118	      // missing this field is malformed, not "oldest").
  1119	      if (typeof payload.sequence !== "number") continue;
  1120	      if (best === null || payload.sequence > best.sequence) {
  1121	        best = { file: full, sequence: payload.sequence };
  1122	      }
  1123	    }
  1124	    if (best === null) {
  1125	      throw new Error(`no pack under ${PACKS_DIR} had a numeric sequence`);
  1126	    }
  1127	    return best.file;
  1128	  }
  1129	
  1130	  function reviewReasonCodesInPack(): string[] {
  1131	    const payload = JSON.parse(
  1132	      fs.readFileSync(latestProductionPackFile(), "utf-8"),
  1133	    ) as { rules?: Array<Record<string, unknown>> };
  1134	    const codes = new Set<string>();
  1135	    for (const rule of payload.rules ?? []) {
  1136	      const effect = rule.effect as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  1137	      if (!effect || typeof effect.reason_code !== "string") continue;
  1138	      // A HUMAN_REVIEW-stage rule contributes its reason on a definite TRUE
  1139	      // (`evaluator.py::evaluate_product`, `_true_reasons`). A HARD_FILTER
  1140	      // rule ALSO contributes its reason — the SAME `effect.reason_code`,
  1141	      // via `_reason_from_rule` — when its own condition is UNKNOWN and it
  1142	      // declares `on_unknown: "HUMAN_REVIEW"`
  1143	      // (`_partition_unknowns_by_policy` + `_reason_from_rule`,
  1144	      // evaluator.py:355-410, 741-751): a rule author asking for human
  1145	      // judgment on an uncertain exclusion outranks merely asking the
  1146	      // applicant for more facts. Support-stage (ELIGIBILITY) on_unknown
  1147	      // escalation feeds SUPPORT_REASON_COPY instead, not this map, so it is
  1148	      // deliberately not included here.
  1149	      if (
  1150	        rule.stage === "HUMAN_REVIEW" ||
  1151	        (rule.stage === "HARD_FILTER" && rule.on_unknown === "HUMAN_REVIEW")
  1152	      ) {
  1153	        codes.add(effect.reason_code);
  1154	      }
  1155	    }
  1156	    return [...codes].sort();
  1157	  }
